question: Can reviewed company facts be attached to historical industry identities without treating selected issuer disclosures as full-industry or leading evidence?
scope: 13 reviewed facts, five issuers, SW2021 full L1/L2/L3 catalogue; no new collection or outcome-fitting

clocks.publication_proxy: inherited publication date strictly before observation date; first-release chain not certified
clocks.inherited_archive: original recorded_at before Shanghai end-of-day; historical archive metadata not equivalent to current verified possession
clocks.ep35_acquisition: actual EP35 fetched_at before Shanghai end-of-day

identity: previous calendar-month membership only, exact exchange-qualified instrument; issuer-to-industry membership is not business-segment-to-industry assignment; ambiguous issuer identities remain unmapped
coverage: distinct observed issuers / distinct identified member security IDs; report known-member and unresolved counts separately; missing membership denominator stays unknown; selected sample coverage is not representativeness
aggregation: retain all facts and company directions separately, no aggregate score or industry stage probability, no sector extrapolation, no multiplication of independent sample count across hierarchy
economics: observed period is 2026 H1, not publication-month economic activity; positive and negative/company explanation facts can coexist
counterfactual: if exact identity missing, ambiguous or outside catalogue, retain failure ledger; if chosen clock is later than asof, exclude fact and retain zero eligible count
validation: full catalogue retained, numerator deduplicated by security_id, future fields excluded, all source hashes, direct mapping checks, clock boundary and ambiguity tests
decision: company fact evidence only; continuous comparable industry variables and independent price-controlled incremental tests remain necessary
